newsitem.title: UK: UK Lady in Leisure sets AIM debut premium.
newsitem.headline: UK Lady in Leisure sets AIM debut premium.

text.p: Shares in Lady in Leisure Plc, the women-only health and fitness club operator, jumped to a premium on Thursday in their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM), dealers said.
The shares, issued at 110p, gained 14-1/2p to 124-1/2p by 1055 GMT, a premium of 13 percent.
The company owns and manages eight health and fitness clubs in the UK but said it aims to establish and further eight clubs in the next 16 months.
The AIM float raised 1.7 million stg for Lady in Leisure, which said the company provided services that were poorly served by mixed clubs.
